decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with little investment that is cheap to keep in the range, though its low visibility means little commitment protects it.
A box trailer series featured prominently on the home page and central to the firm's core trailer business, so its visible commitment and production investment favor persistence.
A specialized car transporter required notable development investment, and any weak demand can be attributed to temporary pandemic and supply disruptions, so management keeps it.
A low-bed series promoted on the home page that is core to the announced product range, so sunk investment and public commitment support continuing it.
The high cover series was publicly showcased and fits the firm's continuous product improvement strategy, so management persists with it.
A second box trailer series that was visibly promoted, and despite possible overlap with B, the commitment and shared production make keeping it the likely choice.
